payload.name: Dissociation of reward anticipation and outcome processing
payload.fact: Anticipation of reward activates the ventral striatum, while reward outcomes activate the ventromedial frontal cortex.

provenance.title: Dissociation of reward anticipation and outcome with event-related fMRI
